records.description: Learn Microsoft technology and support student technical communities.

records.description: Paid campus marketing role introducing students to Copilot.

records.assessmentReason: Paid role; confirm Pitt eligibility and campaign targets.

records.description: Creator partnership for people with an established tech audience.
records.deadlineNotes: Applications reviewed weekly; no closing date published.

records.ambassadorBenefits: Payment per video, free Firecrawl, early access, merch and direct team Slack channel.
records.expectations: Pitch ideas and deliver approved videos covering AI, developer tools or software engineering.
records.eligibility: Established tech audience; follower threshold unspecified.

records.assessmentReason: Paid video work; confirm rates and value to club members.

records.description: Paired campus leads organize student AI learning and projects.

records.eligibility: 18+ undergraduate as of August 2026, graduating after December 2027; work authorization in country of study.

records.restrictions: Cannot currently be an ambassador or intern for another AI program/company.
records.assessmentReason: Funding and stipend support meaningful activity; next intake and exclusivity matter.
